claims.candidate_meaning: Speaker (unknown, the original speaker) states a plan: if in this experiment loss does not drop below 0.1 then the architecture will be overhauled.

missing_argument.reason: The original's condition, speaker, experiment reference, loss threshold, and architecture-overhaul target are all bound; speaker is the original speaker by intrinsic provenance, and the candidate's unknown speaker label does not invent identity.

evidence.quote: 만약 이번 실험에서 loss가 0.1 아래로 안 떨어지면 아키텍처를 갈아엎을 거야.

claims.source_meaning: The speaker says that if in this experiment the loss does not fall below 0.1, they will overhaul the architecture.
claims.text: 원문 화자는 원문 발화 시점의 이번 실험에서 loss가 0.1 아래로 떨어지지 않으면 아키텍처를 갈아엎겠다는 계획을 밝혔다.
